data.display_address: Ellington Beach House, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
Unveil a new standard of luxury with Ellington Beach House, an exquisite offering from Ellington Properties in Palm Jumeirah, Dubai. This distinguished development features tastefully designed residences, ideal for those who seek an exceptional lifestyle with convenient access to premier shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences.


  Residents additionally benefit from the pristine beachfront neighbourhood and the lifestyle thanks to the building's exceptional location at the entrance to the Palm Jumeirah in Dubai. You can easily and without fuss travel across the rest of Dubai thanks to the development's additional connections to the mainland, where you can find world-class accommodations, restaurants, and retail centres.


  The premium design development also has cutting-edge, distinctive architecture with floor to ceiling design windows, allowing you to enjoy the inspirational outside palm view. While the interiors have modern art decors, top class fixtures, and spacious living and bedroom areas for you and your family.


  Finance is available on this property through Premier Property Finance. Call us on +97143233609 for a free consultation.
